Title: Senior Data Scientist - LATAM Content
Description: Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. The Content Data Science and Engineering (DSE) team is passionate about storytelling and bringing our members joy. Our mission to entertain the world is anchored in our content, and data is a crucial component in shaping our comprehensive content strategy. We focus on creating analytical products that support our Content partners in their complex and nuanced decision-making processes. We are a highly collaborative team that partners across Netflix to drive impact. We are seeking a talented Senior Data Scientist to provide key insights to our Content decision makers in LatAm. You will generate insights by scoping and executing deep dive analysis with local partner analytics teams, Consumer Insights, and Finance & Strategy. In success, you will collaborate on existing priorities but also will propose and execute on new opportunities. This role features ample opportunity for project ownership and will support impactful decision-making, across existing content initiatives and novel ones. In This Role You Will Be a strategic thought partner with business stakeholders to define high impact analytical problems and innovative ways to solve them with data. Develop statistical models explaining viewership, content engagement, and other key behavioral patterns. Build dashboards and visualization that enables stakeholders to self-serve metrics and trends effectively. Actively socialize and educate, aiding on interpretation. Translate analytic insights into actionable recommendations for business or content improvement, and communicate these findings clearly to a broad audience. Identify and proactively socialize regional insights, including those that may generalize to opportunities in other markets. What You Will Bring Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to influence stakeholders using clear insights and recommendations. Exceptional thought partnership to build credibility and relationships with stakeholders. Strong statistical knowledge: understanding of predictive modeling; ability to tease out incrementality vs. correlations, confounder identification and amelioration, etc. Basic understanding of experimentation inclu,ding power calculations and interpretation of results. Strong SQL skills and experience with distributed analytic processing technologies (S3, Presto, Hive, & Spark). Strong skills in Python or R. Highly effective in engaging with diverse stakeholders and adept at cultivating strong partnerships. Passionate about communicating difficult concepts to non-technical audiences. Self-starter who thrives under a high level of autonomy. Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills. Enthusiastic about Netflix culture. Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

Title: e-Commerce AI Business Enablement Sr. Lead
Description: The Lead, AI Business Enablement guides the artificial intelligence journey of Newell's LATAM eCommerce business. It is a senior individual contributor role for a curious builder: someone who turns AI capability into commercial results across Amazon, Mercado Libre and other strategic digital customers, and who helps the whole regional organization work smarter along the way. You'll have real freedom to explore, prototype and test ideas — and the backing to scale the ones that succeed. Some experiments won't work, and that's part of the deal. What matters is learning fast, being honest about results and turning the wins into everyday practice across the region. Where You'll Make an Impact Your energy will center on three missions. Mission 1 | Drive Commercial Growth Build the insight-to-action engine that accelerates revenue and profitability across Amazon, Mercado Libre and other strategic digital customers. What you'll do Shape the commercial analytics agenda for the region: sales, market share, pricing, digital shelf, assortment, search performance, retail media, traffic, conversion, availability, Buy Box and profitability. Turn ambiguous business questions into quantified opportunities, business cases and executive-ready recommendations. Partner with Sales, Category Management, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance and Digital to help decisions move from weeks to days. Bring data to commercial priorities and help teams learn from what the numbers say. Success looks like Commercial decisions become faster, better informed and easier to trace to outcomes, with revenue and margin wins the team can celebrate together. Mission 2 | Evolve Ways of Working Champion continuous improvement across the LATAM eCommerce organization: simpler processes, less manual work and good ideas that travel across markets. What you'll do Explore and rethink core commercial processes together with the teams that run them. Reduce manual work through automation and help the best practices spread across markets. Guide cross-functional improvement initiatives from diagnosis to adoption, with empathy for how people experience change. Create playbooks and documentation that help improvements stick. Success looks like A more productive organization: hours returned to commercial teams, fewer handoffs and ways of working that scale naturally across countries. Mission 3 | Explore, Test and Scale AI Take AI from ideas to everyday practice through experimentation: try, test, learn and scale what works. What you'll do Spot and prioritize promising AI use cases across the business, guided by a clear view of potential value. Prototype, pilot and scale solutions such as commercial copilots, AI agents, workflow automation, pricing and competitive intelligence, content generation, reporting automation and knowledge assistants. Care for quality along the way: evaluation, reliability, responsible AI practices and data privacy, including LGPD. Nurture adoption through enablement, training and honest measurement of real usage. Stay curious about the frontier and test emerging AI technologies. Success looks like AI woven into everyday operations, with adoption and impact everyone can see: less manual work, faster execution and a growing competitive edge. How You'll Operate As a P3 in Newell's Job Architecture, you'll work with a high degree of autonomy under broad direction. Shape: the LATAM eCommerce AI enablement roadmap, solution design and prioritization, and regional best practices. Influence: cross-functional, multi-country initiatives, partnering with stakeholders up to Director level. Develop others: mentor analysts across the region and help grow the organization's AI fluency. Recommend: bring investment ideas, vendor options and trade-offs to eCommerce leadership with a clear point of view. Your First Year: Explore, Experiment, Scale A natural arc for the first 12 months, which we'll shape together. Explore — first 90 days: immerse in the business, listen to teams across markets, map workflows and identify the opportunities with the most potential. Experiment — by month six: launch the first pilots in one or two markets, test and learn, and measure openly what works and what doesn't. Scale — by month 12: turn the successful experiments into solutions adopted across the region, and share the learning openly, including from the pilots that didn't make it. What You'll Bring Experience And Skills Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Business or a related quantitative field; an advanced degree (MBA or MS) is a plus. Around seven years or more of experience across eCommerce, commercial analytics, digital transformation or AI solutions, including meaningful hands-on time designing, testing and deploying AI or automation solutions that made it into everyday use. Stories of things you've built: solutions people actually adopted, the results they produced and the experiments that taught you the most. Strong marketplace fluency: the economics of Amazon and Mercado Libre, including retail media, digital shelf, search, Buy Box dynamics, 1P/3P models and profitability drivers. Hands-on comfort with SQL and Python, plus working command of LLM APIs and frameworks (prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, evaluation), enterprise automation (Power Platform, n8n, Make) and advanced Power BI. Confident, clear communication with senior stakeholders, in writing and in the room. Languages Spanish: native or full professional proficiency. English: full professional proficiency. English is the working language with regional and global leadership, and parts of the selection process are conducted in English. Nice to have Consumer goods, retail or marketplace industry experience at scale. Experience with AI governance, model evaluation and data privacy in enterprise environments. Internal copilots or agents you've built that found sustained adoption. Lean Six Sigma or comparable continuous improvement certification. Experience scaling solutions across multi-country organizations. Newell Brands (NASDAQ: NWL) is a leading global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well-known brands, including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Rubbermaid Commercial Products, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, FoodSaver, Dymo, EXPO, Elmer’s, Oster, NUK, Spontex and Campingaz. We are focused on delighting consumers by lighting up everyday moments.

If so, we would love to welcome you to our global community as Manager, Strategic Planning and Analysis! The Strategic Planning & Analysis Manager is an enterprise planning, strategy, and decision-support role that helps leadership determine priorities, sequence initiatives, allocate resources, and align functions around shared strategic goals. The role translates evidence into practical choices, resource implications, and leadership recommendations. This role strengthens enterprise planning by connecting organizational evidence to decisions about strategy, investment, sequencing, resources, and capacity. It integrates inputs from Research, Finance, Academic Programs, IT, Career Readiness, International Markets, and other teams to support timely , aligned decisions. This is an individual-contributor role that leads enterprise planning processes through analysis, influence, facilitation, and cross-functional partnership rather than through direct supervision of staff. The Institute for Study Abroad (IFSA) was founded in 1988 as a provider of study abroad programming for U.S. undergraduates. With student success in mind, the organization creates global learning environments designed to foster the development of critical perspectives, knowledge and skills essential for students to thrive in the future. Offering more than 100 programs in 19 countries, we draw upon theory and evidence-based practice to create a variety of program models and flexible academic options in alignment with the needs of partners and students. Our commitments to inclusive excellence , intercultural agility , individualized learning and enduring impact are present in every aspect of our programs. We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable organization and we look for positive-minded, adaptable people from diverse communities and cultures to help us transform our sector and change the lives of the students we serve. In This Position, Your Responsibilities Would Include Strategic Planning & Prioritization: Lead annual, multi-year, and scenario-based planning processes that help leadership evaluate opportunities against organizational goals and determine enterprise-wide priorities. Recommend sequencing while balancing growth, risk, resources, feasibility, and capacity. Enterprise Portfolio Management: Assess competing initiatives across departments, programs, markets, and operations. Develop portfolio frameworks that compare strategic alignment, impact, cost, risk, feasibility, dependencies, and resource requirements, and recommend where resources should increase, decrease, shift, or be delayed. Executive Decision Support & Scenario Modeling: Translate complex research, data, and organizational context into actionable recommendations. Develop strategic scenarios, model potential outcomes, identify implications and dependencies, and present leadership with clear options and recommended courses of action. Cross-Functional Alignment & Enterprise Coordination: Coordinate planning across departments, functions, and regions so teams work toward shared organizational objectives. Facilitate stakeholder discussions, integrate distributed information into coherent planning outputs, and help build consensus around strategic direction. Market, Environmental & Organizational Intelligence: Analyze competitive trends, market developments, customer and partner needs, industry shifts, emerging risks, and internal performance signals. Identify opportunities and threats, assess future scenarios, and recommend strategic responses or organizational adjustments. Resource Allocation, Capacity Planning & Strategic Measurement: Help determine how budgets, staffing, technology, and operational capacity should be deployed to support strategic priorities. Evaluate ROI and resource implications, define success metrics and strategic KPIs, and recommend corrective actions when performance diverges from expectations. Additional responsibilities as assigned. Additional Responsibilities include: Develop reusable prioritization tools, scoring models, portfolio views, templates, and decision frameworks. Conduct ad hoc strategic analyses in response to emerging organizational questions, opportunities, or challenges. Partner with functional leaders to clarify decision needs, define analytical questions, and synthesize findings. Support a stronger culture of evidence-based, enterprise-level, decision-oriented planning. Minimum of 3–5 years of progressive experience in enterprise planning, strategic planning, portfolio management, business analysis, consulting, institutional planning, market analysis, or a related analytical strategy role. Professional proficiency in written and spoken English, at CEFR B2 or higher, including the ability to present complex analysis clearly to senior leaders Strong ability to synthesize complex information and translate it into implications, options, and recommendations for senior leaders. Experience developing decision frameworks, business cases, prioritization models, portfolio assessments, dashboards, scenario analyses, or executive briefing materials. Ability to evaluate tradeoffs across strategic value, financial impact, feasibility, risk, timing, resources, and capacity. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex analysis clearly to executive audiences. Advanced Excel skills and comfort working with quantitative data, qualitative findings, mixed-method evidence, and incomplete information. Strong intercultural communication skills and demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with diverse communities and stakeholders Legal authorization to work in Mexico, physically reside in Mexico City. Experience supporting executive leadership, Board preparation, strategic planning cycles, enterprise initiatives, or investment prioritization decisions. Familiarity with technology prioritization, operational improvement, digital transformation, or AI-related investment evaluation.
